Chris

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: RApache vs Rengine
parts:
Here's the link describing REngine:

http://rforge.net/Rserve/ - then search for REngine

From what little I've read just now, it's a Java client interface to
Rserve. If you want RoR and R integration then rApache will work just
fine; just implement your R code as web services and serve them from
rApache. I've done this on a few applications. On could also use
Rserve with RoR, but one would have to write a Ruby Rserve client
since communicating with Rserve is done with a custom binary protocol
over TCP.

Jeff
